Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
I haven't asked a weird rules question in awhile, so..

Antonio Veradas gets +1 stealth when equipping with a weapon.

Vast Wealth lets the minion with it take a +1 stealth equip action to
find a piece of equipment in the deck.

If Antonio has Vast Wealth, and the only equipment in the library is
weapons, would he get +1 additional stealth on the VW action? Or
does the ambiguity of the situation mean that his special can't kick
in even if you *know* it's going to be a weapon?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Jozxyqk" <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote in message
news:luC1d.175457$9d6.128379@attbi_s54...

> I haven't asked a weird rules question in awhile, so..

Slacker. :-)

> Antonio Veradas gets +1 stealth when equipping with a weapon.
>
> Vast Wealth lets the minion with it take a +1 stealth equip action to
> find a piece of equipment in the deck.
>
> If Antonio has Vast Wealth, and the only equipment in the library is
> weapons, would he get +1 additional stealth on the VW action? Or

No.

> does the ambiguity of the situation mean that his special can't kick
> in even if you *know* it's going to be a weapon?

This.

Even if everyone knew (you exhausted your library but still have a
full hand when someone else calls a Reinforcements and names you,
and you select a weapon to move to your library), the Vast Wealth
action is still just generic "equipping", not "equipping with a weapon".

other players at the table. On the other hand, if you have more than just a
weapon in there, I don't know how you would handle it - after all, you can't
